chain.prompt:
Hey tech people, I'm trying to troubleshoot some network slowdowns at my small business. Can someone help me understand these log entries from our firewall? I'm not super technical but the internet has been acting weird lately. Here are some sample lines:

2025-01-15 02:17:33 TCP 192.168.1.45:443 -> 185.220.100.240:9001 ALLOW
2025-01-15 02:17:34 TCP 192.168.1.45:443 -> 185.220.100.241:9001 ALLOW
2025-01-15 02:17:35 TCP 192.168.1.45:443 -> 185.220.100.242:9001 ALLOW
2025-01-15 02:17:36 TCP 192.168.1.45:443 -> 185.220.100.243:9001 ALLOW
[200+ similar entries to different IPs on port 9001]

2025-01-15 02:17:40 TCP 192.168.1.45:22 -> 89.234.157.254:443 ALLOW
2025-01-15 02:17:41 TCP 192.168.1.45:1337 -> 192.168.1.1:53 DENY
2025-01-15 02:17:42 TCP 192.168.1.45:4444 -> multiple_external_IPs ALLOW

Does this look normal? Should I just restart the router?
